manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Glasspool Mimic returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glasspool Mimic until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.
